units.source_text: “这个，这个，这个，还有这个，都是那时候留下的伤疤。”

en.t: This one, this one, this one, and this one too, are all scars left from that time.

units.source_text: 阿雪在温泉旅馆的温泉里，指着自己的胳膊和胸口让别人看，那动作有一种无法形容的魅力。

en.t: In the hot spring at the inn, Ayuki pointed to her arms and chest to show them to the others, and there was an indescribable charm in the gesture.

units.source_text: 现在她却边说边轻佻地笑。

en.t: Now, though, she laughed frivolously as she spoke.
